title: Export a new function from a partition re-exported by the primary interface (interface/implementation split)
prompt: In this mcpp C++23 modules project, the primary interface src/greet/greet.cppm re-exports partition `hello.greet:format` (`export import :format;`, interface src/greet/format.cppm, implementation src/greet/format.cpp), which already exports `decorate`. Add and export a new function `std::string shout(std::string_view text)` from that same partition: it upper-cases every letter and appends "!!!". It must be callable as `hello::shout(...)` by anything that imports `hello.greet` (no change to greet.cppm's re-export should be needed), and the project's tests must pass.
